newsitem.title: USA: Frontier says Sonet costs less than thought.
newsitem.headline: Frontier says Sonet costs less than thought.

text.p: Frontier Corp said Monday the SONET fiber network it is purchasing from Qwest Communications Corp will cost the company about 15 percent less than originally announced.

Frontier's portion of the overall cost of the network would be reduced with the addition of another large participant, Frontier said. Qwest has announced it has secured GTE Corp as an additional participant in the construction of the network, Frontier said. This, combined with additional reductions in the cost of materials, lowers Frontier's required investment in the network, Frontier said.
